page_title: ARS 1-0 MCI | Arsenal v Manchester City 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The expression of the referee Michael Oliver is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is shown a yellow card.
90+3' A yellow card is awarded to Ederson (Manchester City).
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 60233.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
86' 1 - 0 Goal! Kai Havertz passes the ball to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Ederson couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
86' 11:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

84' Arsenal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
82' Nice passing game by Manchester City. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
79' Rough tackle by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Arsenal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Thomas Partey (Arsenal) is replacing Jorginho.
75' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Eddie Nketiah is replaced by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Oleksandr Zinchenko.
75' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
74' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
74' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Manchester City earn a corner.
73' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

71' The game is interrupted. Kyle Walker (Manchester City) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Arsenal.
70' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
69' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Substitution. Julian Alvarez makes his way off the pitch and Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.
68' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) replacing Mateo Kovacic.
68' It will be a substitution. John Stones (Manchester City) is ready to enter the pitch as Rico Lewis walks off.
67' The ball is cleared after Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared David Raya (Arsenal).

65' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
62' Declan Rice (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
61' Manchester City keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
59' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.

58' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
57' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
56' Arsenal concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
53' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Ederson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
52' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ben White (Arsenal) and blew his whistle.
51' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Ederson's superb save the ball would have probably ended up inside the left post.

50' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
50' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

47' A cross by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Mikel Arteta gives a chance to Gabriel Martinelli and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece. Arsenal win a free kick.
45+1' William Saliba (Arsenal) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
41' A cross into the box from Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
39' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
38' Arsenal are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball is behind the touchline and Arsenal will take a throw-in.
37' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
36' Arsenal are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
35' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City). Michael Oliver saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.

34' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
33' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

32' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
31' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
29' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
28' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) blazes well wide of the right post.
26' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) commits a foul during an attacking move. Manchester City have been awarded a free kick.
24' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
23' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
23' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
18' The referee blows his whistle as Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
16' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Jorginho (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
11' Ben White (Arsenal) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared.
9' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
9' Arsenal are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.

6' Great chance! Nathan Ake (Manchester City) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.

6' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
5' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City. Phil Foden (Manchester City) is about to take a corner kick.
4' Arsenal are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. It's a throw-in for Manchester City.
3' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
